styles.name: sri-yantra
styles.description: Sri Yantra: square gate with four doors, enclosing circle, and the interlocking Shiva (up) and Shakti (down) triangles laid one by one around a pulsing bindu, flanked by a progress path

styles.name: lotus-mandala
styles.description: Lotus mandala: eight pointed outer petals and eight inner petals around a seed-pod ring, opening petal by petal and slowly turning between two progress paths

styles.name: rose-window
styles.description: Rose windows: a row of Gothic roses, each a stone rim and hub with eight radiating lancet mullions and a ring of foiled oculi between them, the tracery glazed window by window as progress rises

styles.name: bagua
styles.description: Bagua: the eight I-Ching trigrams in Fu Xi order (☰ ☱ ☲ ☳ | ☴ ☵ ☶ ☷), solid and broken bars appearing one by one either side of a turning yin-yang

styles.name: enneagram
styles.description: Enneagram: nine points on a circle, the 9-3-6 triangle and the 1-4-2-8-5-7 hexad traced line by line with progress, a spark running the hexad's cycle

styles.name: rangoli
styles.description: Rangoli kolam: a row of kolams, each a diamond of nine pulli dots with a loop drawn around every dot by a travelling pen, then framed in a diamond border, kolam after kolam as progress rises

styles.name: chartres-labyrinth
styles.description: Chartres labyrinth: the cathedral floor labyrinth seen in perspective — nested circuit walls with their turning gaps — while a walker traces the single path circuit by circuit to the centre, a dotted trail behind and the progress path either side

styles.name: mandala-tessellation
styles.description: Mandala tessellation: a row of edge-sharing hexagonal tiles, each laid out with six spokes, a hexagram and a turning inner hexagon — the tiling fills tile by tile as progress rises

styles.name: dharma-wheel
styles.description: Dharma wheel (Dharmachakra): rim, nave and eight knobbed spokes — the wheel of the law rolling along its path as progress turns it

styles.name: vesica-rosette
styles.description: Vesica rosettes: a row of six-petal compass rosettes, each petal a vesica lens cut by two arcs of the circle's own radius, petals blooming one by one and rosette by rosette as progress rises

styles.name: star-of-david
styles.description: Star of David hexagram: two interlocking equilateral triangles inked edge by edge and slowly turning, on a progress path
